T000003007279.title: [Elis SA, 2023 Sales/ Trading Statement Call, Jan 30, 2024](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$DOCID_T000003007279)

text: We serve public hospitals as well. [#2832](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-2832)
And in a context where in health care, we have a lot of public contracts. [#741](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-741)

The healthcare market is also growing on the back of public funding with modern hospitals and clinics being constructed, which therefore represented the area of potential growth for us. [#103](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003054377-103)

In Mexico meanwhile, a public tender has been launched to reset all volumes following a reorganization of the Mexican federal healthcare system. [#136](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-136)
So we are serving the re national chains of hospitals, either private or public. [#2502](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-2502)

So it has all the industries that we are working with, so hospitality, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, several industries, also has important health care system with a lot of public program, the public hospitals that deploys many public services to the population. [#2435](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-2435)

But you know that big hospitals in Germany are under pressure for economical reason, and in some cases, in some public tender, they put only a price criteria, no criteria regarding quality, reliability and so on. [#847](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-847)

We try to convince the public hospital to -- so we make the consultation and when we see this and we give the numbers of, for example, all the [ maladies ] that you can get in this kind of process, imagine if you sleep in a bed where it has been washed this in these laundries, it's terrible. [#2876](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-2876)

This tender was previously structured as a single lot but has now shifted to a multi-lot format and a diversifying supplier to optimize prices even at the potential expense of the service quality as the phenomenon that we have already seen play out in the Healthcare market in Europe in the past. [#137](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-137)
So as you know, a lot of services are done by municipalities, like health care or whatever. [#480](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-480)

Ces enquêtes et procédures résultent d'un audit réalisé par le Contrôleur Général de l'État de São Paulo (CGA) auprès de différents hôpitaux de l'État, au cours duquel la CGA a relevé un nombre élevé de contrats conclus en urgence (en exception d'une procédure d'appel d'offres telle que normalement prévue par le droit brésilien) et a décidé de (i) initier une enquête à l'encontre de plusieurs hôpitaux et sociétés concernés afin de vérifier si des irrégularités ont accompagné la conclusion en urgence de ces contrats et (ii) transmettre les conclusions de son audit à différentes autorités brésiliennes afin que ces dernières puissent, à leur discrétion, initier une enquête. [#403](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000227468226-403)
The second one is around the health care market. [#1410](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1410)
